title: Make OpenAI-compatible API key optional for local codebase indexing
author: Neonsy
lessons: Optional fields need consistency across all layers -- UI, config, factory, and service must all be updated together
SDK constructor constraints drive sentinel values -- a named constant like OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_DUMMY_API_KEY = 'EMPTY' documents the workaround cleanly
Config restart detection needs testing when field optionality changes -- key-to-empty and empty-to-key transitions are new state machine edges
Author transparency about untested scenarios helps reviewers focus verification effort
